title: TECHNICAL SITE ENGINEER – CIVIL
description:
🚀 WE’RE HIRING \| TECHNICAL SITE ENGINEER – CIVIL
 



  





 🏢 Peejay Max is looking for passionate Technical Site Engineers to support product demonstrations, provide technical guidance, and build lasting relationships with customers across Kerala.
 



  





 📍 Locations: Ernakulam, Thrissur \& Calicut (Kerala Candidates Mandatory)
 



 🧑‍💼 Experience: 0–3 Years (Site Engineering / Techno\-Marketing)
 



  





 🔑 Key Job Roles
 



  





 Conduct site visits to demonstrate product applications and provide technical guidance to clients.
 



 Build and maintain strong relationships with Customers.
 



 Resolve customer queries by working closely with the technical team.
 



 Support customers throughout product trials and ensure smooth product adoption.
 



  





 ✅ Key Requirements
 



  





 B.Tech / Diploma in Civil Engineering (Mandatory)
 



 0–2 years of experience in site engineering, sales support or techno\-marketing
 



 Strong communication and presentation skills
 



 Good technical understanding of construction materials and products
 



 Willingness to travel extensively on business requirements
 



  





 📩 Send your CV to: hr@peejaymax.com
 



 🌐 Visit: www.peejaymax.com
 



  





 Join Peejay Max and help deliver technical excellence that builds stronger projects across Kerala. 🚀
